name: noibu
description: Analyze ecommerce conversion, shopper behavior, errors, and experiments using Noibu data.

interface.longDescription: Built for ecommerce, the Noibu plugin bridges the gap between customer experience and revenue by connecting ChatGPT directly to your store's session, error, and conversion data through Noibu — and to the marketing, support, and commerce platforms that put insight into motion. Go beyond analysis: surface what's costing you revenue, take action across your stack, build workflows to automate work end-to-end.
defaultPrompt: How is my store doing in the last 24 hours?
Compare checkout performance with the previous 30 days.
Find evidence-backed A/B tests to improve add-to-cart rate.
